Provides leadership and direction through a large team of professionals and/or junior managers.
Provide leadership to drive optimization and efficiencies in projects
Assist management in guiding and influencing decisions that conform to business objectives

Continually drive and manage controls enhancements focused on increasing efficiency and reducing risk.

Responsible for the coordination and comprehensive management of issues with key stakeholders

Management Policy, Standards and Procedures
Develop standard and risk controls reporting to ensure sound, reliable, and consistent information exists across the organization, enabling better management and decision making in line with the expectations senior of management, Board, and Regulators.
Oversee the operations of Citi's governance committees, including coordinating meetings, managing agendas, and ensuring follow-up on action items.

10+ years of experience in operational risk management, compliance, audit, or other control-related functions in the financial services industry.
Ability to identify, measure, and manage key risks and controls.
Track record leading Control related projects and programs
Ability to see the big pictures with high attention to critical details.
Develop and implement strategy and process improvement initiatives.
Comprehensive knowledge of Citi’s businesses and functions and their risk profiles.
Developing new ideas and improving current processes to proactively mitigate risks.
Requires an ability to provide challenge and make recommendation for risk and controls remediation.
Expert knowledge in the development and execution for controls.
Proven experience in control related functions in the financial industry.
Proven experience in implementing sustainable solutions and improving processes.
Expert understanding of compliance laws, rules, regulations, and best practices.
Deep understanding of Citi’s Policies, Standards, and Procedures.
Strong leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
Strong analytical skills to evaluate complex risk and control activities and processes.
Ability to deliver compelling presentations and influence executive audiences.
Strong sense of accountability and ownership, with strong results orientation.
Excellent communication skills; ability to engage and inspire across stakeholder groups.
Exceptional command in Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Education
Bachelor's/University degree, Master's degree preferred

The
Junior Middle Office Support Analyst
acts as the critical operational bridge between Front Office Sales & Trading desks, Clients, Risk Management, and Back Office Clearing & Settlement teams. Based in
Shanghai
, this role is responsible for daily trade capture, allocation, pre-settlement confirmation, position monitoring, and operational lifecycle support domestic securities
This position offers an entry-to-junior professional hands-on exposure to onshore market mechanisms, trading platform operations, regulatory reporting frameworks, and direct trade lifecycle management within a fast-paced securities trading environment.
Key Responsibilities
Trade Capture, Validation & Lifecycle Management
Manage post-execution trade monitoring, matching, and confirmation distribution to QFII clients and domestic institutional clients.
Monitor trade status across local trading systems (e.g., Rootnet / internal middle office systems).
Assist in managing post-trade lifecycle events, such as commission amendments.
Front-to-Back Operational Coordination
Act as the primary point of contact for Front Office traders and institutional sales regarding trade booking anomalies, static data issues, and execution queries.
Partner closely with Back Office Settlement teams to ensure timely trade handoff, straight-through processing (STP), and early prevention of settlement fails.
Interface with Finance and custodian banks to support daily end-of-day (EOD)commission receiving reconciliation.
Position Monitoring & Trade Reconciliation
Conduct daily T+0 / T+1 trade and position reconciliations across Front Office booking systems and Middle Office databases.
Investigate and remediate trade discrepancy breaks (price, quantity, counterparty identifiers, fee structures, or account allocations).
Maintain comprehensive records and audit trails for all post trade processing.
Client Servicing & Onboarding Support
Assist in maintaining client account static data, SSI (Standard Settlement Instructions) verification, and counterparty trading configurations.
Facilitate client trade confirmations, statement generation, and ad-hoc trade report queries for institutional accounts.
Support client operational onboarding workflows and trading line setup in collaboration with Compliance and Client Onboarding teams.
Regulatory Compliance & Operational Risk Controls
Adhere strictly to operational risk controls, segregation of duties, and desk execution mandates.
Support regular and ad-hoc regulatory filings and transaction reporting to regulatory authorities and self-regulatory bodies (e.g., CSRC, SAC - Securities Association of China).
Support internal/external audits and risk assessments by preparing trade records and operational review materials.
System Enhancements & Process Optimization
Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for Middle Office systems, trading connectivity upgrades, and automation initiatives.
Identify operational bottlenecks and suggest workflow enhancements to increase automation and reduce manual booking errors.
Required Qualifications & Competencies
Education & Experience
Education: Bachelor’s degree or above in Finance, Financial Engineering, Economics, Information Management, Accounting, or a related quantitative/business field.
Experience: 0–2 years of relevant experience in a Middle Office, Trade Support, Trade Operations, or Brokerage Operations capacity. Relevant internship experience within securities firms, investment banks, asset managers, or custody banks is highly valued.
Market & Technical Knowledge
Sound understanding of China’s domestic capital markets, exchange trading mechanisms (SSE, SZSE, BSE),
Basic familiarity with domestic financial software / order management platforms (e.g., Hundsun / 恒生, Rootnet/根网, Kingstar / 金仕达, Wind/万得, Bloomberg, or proprietary OMS/EMS).
Strong technical acumen in Microsoft Excel (Formulas, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP). Practical exposure to Python, SQL, or VBA for data reconciliation and automation is a distinct advantage.
Language & Communication Skills
Mandarin: Native or bilingual fluency (essential for rapid interaction with local traders, brokers, and exchanges).
English: Strong professional working proficiency in both written and spoken English (for cross-border institutional client communication, documentation, and reporting).
Behavioral Attributes
Fast-Paced Problem Solving: High composure and rapid responsiveness to trade discrepancies under market execution pressure.
Meticulous Attention to Detail: Rigorous accuracy in data entry, verification, and numeric reconciliations.
Stakeholder Management: Effective interpersonal skills to coordinate between demanding Front Office desks and detail-oriented Back Office teams.

jobs.descriptionText:
Role Overview
The
Junior Analyst – China Securities Settlement
is responsible for supporting the end-to-end post-trade lifecycle, trade matching, clearing, and settlement operations for domestic Chinese securities products. Based in
Shanghai
, this role interfaces directly with domestic market infrastructures, local brokers, custodians, and internal cross-functional teams (including Trading Desks, Middle Office, Cash Operations, Compliance, and Technology).
This entry-to-junior level position is well-suited for a detail-oriented professional looking to build deep expertise in China's evolving financial market architecture, clearing mechanisms, and regulatory landscape (including QFI, CIBM Direct, Stock/Bond Connect, and domestic onshore market flows).
Key Responsibilities
Trade Processing & Settlement Execution
Perform daily pre-matching, validation, confirmation, and settlement execution for local securities transactions across equities (A-shares), fixed income (interbank and exchange-traded bonds), repos, and fund products.
Operate and monitor direct interfaces with domestic central depositories and clearing houses:
ChinaClear (CSDC) – China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation
CCDC (ChinaBond) – China Central Depository & Clearing Co., Ltd.
SHCH – Shanghai Clearing House
Ensure strict adherence to market cut-off times, Delivery versus Payment (DVP) rules, and localized settlement cycles
Reconciliation & Exception Management
Perform daily cash and securities position reconciliations between internal books/records and depository statements.
Actively investigate, track, and resolve unmatched trades, trade fails, breaks, and discrepancy logs.
Coordinate with counterparties, execution brokers, and clearing agents to remediate exceptions prior to settlement deadlines.
Client & Stakeholder Communication
Provide day-to-day operational support to internal trading desks, institutional clients.
Prepare operational summaries, daily transaction reporting, and query responses in a timely, professional manner.
Liaise with domestic sub-custodians and local market participants on operational updates and market-specific requirements.
Risk, Controls & Regulatory Compliance
Maintain strict adherence to internal operational risk controls, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and escalation protocols.
Support regulatory reporting and compliance workflows in accordance with guidelines from the People's Bank of China (PBOC), China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE).
Maintain clean audit trails and accurate record-keeping for all settlement activity.
Continuous Improvement & Projects
Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system upgrades, workflow automation, and market infrastructure releases.
Identify opportunities to eliminate manual handoffs, reduce straight-through processing (STP) leakage, and enhance operational efficiency.
Required Qualifications & Competencies
Education & Experience
Education: Bachelor’s degree or above in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, Financial Engineering, or a related discipline.
Experience: 0–2 years of experience in financial services operations, custody, clearing, or trade support. Fresh graduates with strong relevant internship experience in banking or securities firms are encouraged to apply.
Technical & Market Knowledge
Fundamental understanding of China's onshore capital markets, financial instruments (equities, bonds, repos), and market infrastructure (CSDC, CCDC, SHCH).
Familiarity with cross-border investment access schemes (QFI, CIBM Direct, Bond Connect, Stock Connect) is advantageous.
High proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Knowledge of Excel VBA, SQL, or Python for operational reporting automation is a plus.

Trade Processing & Settlement Execution

  • Perform daily pre-matching, validation, confirmation, and settlement execution for local securities transactions across equities (A-shares), fixed income (interbank and exchange-traded bonds), repos, and fund products.

    • ChinaClear (CSDC) – China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation
    • CCDC (ChinaBond) – China Central Depository & Clearing Co., Ltd.
    • SHCH – Shanghai Clearing House
  • Ensure strict adherence to market cut-off times, Delivery versus Payment (DVP) rules, and localized settlement cycles

Reconciliation & Exception Management

  • Perform daily cash and securities position reconciliations between internal books/records and depository statements.
  • Actively investigate, track, and resolve unmatched trades, trade fails, breaks, and discrepancy logs.
  • Coordinate with counterparties, execution brokers, and clearing agents to remediate exceptions prior to settlement deadlines.


Client & Stakeholder Communication

  • Provide day-to-day operational support to internal trading desks, institutional clients.
  • Prepare operational summaries, daily transaction reporting, and query responses in a timely, professional manner.
  • Liaise with domestic sub-custodians and local market participants on operational updates and market-specific requirements.


Risk, Controls & Regulatory Compliance

  • Maintain strict adherence to internal operational risk controls, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and escalation protocols.
  • Support regulatory reporting and compliance workflows in accordance with guidelines from the People's Bank of China (PBOC), China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE).
  • Maintain clean audit trails and accurate record-keeping for all settlement activity.


Continuous Improvement & Projects

  • Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system upgrades, workflow automation, and market infrastructure releases.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate manual handoffs, reduce straight-through processing (STP) leakage, and enhance operational efficiency.

  • High proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Knowledge of Excel VBA, SQL, or Python for operational reporting automation is a plus.

  • Mandarin: Native or bilingual proficiency (required for day-to-day liaisons with local clearing institutions, brokers, and market bodies).

Fidelity International offers world class investment solutions and retirement expertise. As a privately owned, independent company, investment is our only business. We are driven by the needs of our clients, not by shareholders. Our vision is to deliver innovative client solutions for a better future.
Our people are passionate, engaged, smart and curious, and we give them the independence and the confidence to make a difference. While we take pride in the excellence of our investment solutions and client service, we know we can always do better. We are honest, respectful and make tough calls, challenging the status quo to achieve better outcomes through innovation. Above all else, we always put our clients first.
About Your Team
The Enterprise Network Security Services team is part of the Enterprise Network & Multimedia Services group, within the Enterprise Infrastructure Services technical division.
The Enterprise Infrastructure Services (EIS) division delivers secure, reliable, and globally accessible IT infrastructure (both on-premises and cloud) supporting Fidelity’s applications, services, and dynamic working environment. The Enterprise Network & Multimedia Services group provides global network connectivity solutions across 60+ office locations, core data centers, and cloud partners. It also delivers multimedia connectivity through telephony and conferencing systems both on-premises and in the cloud. The group aims to ensure resilient, high-performance network and multimedia services company-wide and on a global scale.
The Enterprise Network Security Services team is a dynamic global unit with members across APAC, India, and the UK. It is responsible for the full lifecycle of network security services, covering product strategy, architecture, implementation, operations, and lifecycle governance. The team manages and continuously evolves key security platforms including Palo Alto next-generation firewall technologies and Cisco Secure Workload (CSW) alongside identity-based access control and secure internet access services. Working closely with Cyber Security, Architecture, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams, the group continually enhances Fidelity's security posture through network segmentation, Zero Trust principles, automation, AI-assisted security capabilities, and continuous compliance improvement.
About Your Role
As a Technical Consultant within the Enterprise Network Security Services team, you will play a key role in the design, implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Fidelity's global network security platforms and services. You will work closely with Engineering teams, Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders to deliver and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient network security solutions.
The role combines deep technical expertise with solution design, project delivery, operational excellence, and technology modernization. You will contribute to strategic initiatives, support major transformation programs, and help evolve the network security portfolio through automation, cloud adoption, zero-trust architectures, and AI-enabled security capabilities.
About You
The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in enterprise network security engineering and architecture, with a proven track record of delivering complex security solutions and supporting large-scale technology transformation initiatives within enterprise environments. Experience within financial services or other highly regulated industries is highly advantageous. You should be comfortable working across architecture, engineering, operations, and project delivery, ensuring security solutions are effectively designed, implemented, and transitioned into service.
You should have strong experience translating business and security requirements into practical technical solutions and operational processes. This includes developing and reviewing solution designs, supporting technology roadmaps, defining technical standards, and ensuring solutions meet requirements for security, resilience, compliance, and operational efficiency. Experience participating in major programs, technology migrations, vendor engagements, and cross-functional delivery projects will be highly valued.

Key Responsibilities
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, someone who can balance the demands to support business growth versus the need for rigorous control? Be part of our Collateral and Margin Management team
Understand the F2B operational risks and responsible for the service delivery of daily margin and collateral management for Asia Pacific
Work closely with Traders to facilitate margin calls, recalls, pledging activities and to meet tight market deadlines.
Perform front-to-back controls to ensure collateral position and trades are properly reconciled
Engage with external clients and internal partners (Trading, Account Managers, Settlements & Confirmation, Finance, etc...) to provide operational support and independent advice on margin flow and operational risks

You’ll be working in the Global Collateral and Margin Management team in China WX. At least 1+ years of banking experience
The ability to pick up new tasks quickly in a fast-paced environment
